title: Ôn luyện Từ vựng thi vào 10 số 74: Our Heritage (Review)

lessons.title: 1(106w)
lessons.contentHtml:
Read the text and do the following tasks.

Vietnamese lifestyle has changed significantly over the years. Then, life was simpler, and many people lived in rural areas, depending on farming for their livelihood. Traditional customs and community activities were a big feature of daily life. Now, the lifestyle has developed with greater access to various opportunities, especially in cities. The rise of technology and modern industries has brought about a huge difference in how people live, work, and communicate. The popularity of urban living has grown when more people move to cities for better jobs and education. While traditional values are still important, Vietnam’s lifestyle today is a blend of old and new influences.
